environment.description: Quarkus 3.2 native-image serverless function deployed on AWS EKS 1.28 with Fargate profile. Pod runs in namespace 'functions' with default service account. No network restrictions applied. IMDSv1 enabled on underlying node (hop limit=2 for Fargate). Pod has unrestricted egress. The race condition in credential caching allows an attacker to trigger concurrent requests that exploit the use-after-free pattern to leak stale credentials, and the SSRF to metadata service (169.254.169.254) succeeds, returning real IAM temporary credentials.
